decisions.reason: The rye country bread fits the core bread range, runs on existing production at negligible holding cost, and has shown no negative signal, so the option stays open.
The seeded rye mixed bread is a cheap variant of established recipes with no evidence of weak demand, so keeping it remains worthwhile.
The dark malt rye bread overlaps with other rye products, which slightly raises the risk of pruning, but its low maintenance cost justifies keeping it until results show weak demand.
Since the premium raisin stollen was withdrawn, the marzipan stollen now carries more of the seasonal stollen business, and its minimal holding cost makes another Christmas season worth observing.
The ancient grain bread is positioned as the firm's newest masterpiece and its prospects are still uncertain, so abandoning the option now would be premature.
